scope: BGS eight-document delivery readiness and bounded Review/Revision
changes: Shared author/review instructions define readiness by the next consumer's necessary decisions, not perfection.
Blockers require source evidence, downstream impact and an observable closure condition; deferred work needs an owner and needed-by point.
Platform facts require supplied contracts, authoritative documentation or proportional capability evidence; final feel, balance and rendering remain later validation.
Review instructions permit one semantic inspection, one grouped correction and targeted verification; unresolved blockers require evidence or owner/user direction.
Native reviewer uses existing maxTurns=32 and cannot invoke Agent to launch further reviewers. This is an execution ceiling, not a Token/Credit cap or proof of acceptance.
A user-triggered Review ending without a valid milestone conclusion no longer silently schedules another Review.
Existing reference checker also validates explicitly cited retained files under docs, including calculation inputs/scripts; missing, empty, external and transient evidence blocks handoff.
Existing formula and geometry tools remain in use. No whole-document schema, new decision registry, semantic regex gate or extra review stage was added.
Checking Skill describes evidence and finding methods; ownership and work limits remain in assignment prompts and native runtime configuration.

verification.wholeRepositoryTypecheck: failed; reported errors are in files not edited for this change, including sceneContentAdapter, project-turn-native.test, subagentSystemPrompt.test and sdkTaskNotification.test

limits: The native turn ceiling bounds execution; counting semantic correction cycles remains an instruction, not a mechanical semantic classifier.
Reference/evidence-file validation does not prove the contents, platform facts, ownership or semantic agreement correct.
No automatic event-coverage/unit checker was invented for unconstrained prose; only existing supported formula/geometry checks and explicit sources are used.
Local tests do not establish that the model will detect all semantic issues. Real paid behavior remains unverified.
Previous generated documents remain unchanged and retain their independently reported semantic issues.
Existing dependency batches were preserved; this change does not broaden downstream edit authority or automatically accept a changed baseline.
